facts.text: The historic Getreidegasse lies just outside the hotel and has been a thoroughfare since Roman times.
facts.excerpt: Just outside the hotel, near Salzburg’s train station, lies the distinguished Getreidegasse – a historic thoroughfare since Roman times and home to world-renowned boutiques.

facts.text: Mozart's birthplace is just a few steps from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Just a few steps from our hotel you will find Mozart's birthplace, one of Salzburg's most popular attractions.

facts.text: The Festival Hall is just across the street from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: the famous Festival Hall is just across the street

facts.text: When the Salzburg Festival took place for the first time in 1920, the hotel was the festival's first host.
facts.excerpt: When the Salzburg Festival took place for the first time in 1920, we were the Salzburg Festival's first host.

facts.text: Hohensalzburg Fortress, Europe's largest castle complex, can be reached on foot from the hotel in ten minutes.
facts.excerpt: The Hohensalzburg Fortress, Europe’s largest castle complex located in the center of Salzburg, can be reached on foot in just ten minutes.

facts.text: Restaurant Herzl serves Austrian cuisine in a modern yet cozy atmosphere.
facts.excerpt: Restaurant Herzl offers pleasurable experiences in a modern yet cozy atmosphere. Enjoy a selection of exclusive culinary offers and discover Austria’s cuisine and its various facets.

facts.text: The hotel regularly hosts special culinary events at Restaurant Herzl and Bar Goldener Hirsch.
facts.excerpt: Discover the special events and exclusive offers we regularly host at Restaurant Herzl and Bar Goldener Hirsch.

facts.text: The rooms are elegant and traditionally furnished.
facts.excerpt: experience luxury par excellence at our elegant and traditionally furnished rooms

facts.text: The hotel is child-friendly and welcomes guests of all ages.
facts.excerpt: the tradition-steeped and child-friendly Hotel Goldener Hirsch welcomes guests of all ages.

facts.text: Haus der Natur, with exhibitions, a zoo area and science stations, is a stone's throw from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Haus der Natur ("The House of Nature") is situated just a stone's throw away from the Hotel Goldener Hirsch.

facts.text: The Toy Museum, known for its antique toys, is just around the corner from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The Toy Museum is famous for its collection of antique toys and is located just around the corner of Hotel Goldener Hirsch.

facts.text: The inn first welcomed guests in the 15th century.
facts.excerpt: this legendary inn, which first welcomed guests in the 15th-century

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of the medieval old town, surrounded by shops with wrought iron guild signs.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is in the heart of the medieval old town, surrounded by shops displaying wrought iron guild signs.

facts.text: The interiors feature vaulted ceilings, antique farmers' furniture and deer and stag heads, and staff wear lederhosen and dirndls.
facts.excerpt: the vaulted ceilings, antique farmers’ furniture, deer and stag heads, and staff in lederhosen and dirndls

facts.text: Driving in the area can be difficult because of pedestrian zones and confusing road signs; the train from Vienna or Munich is an alternative.
facts.excerpt: driving can be a hassle—pedestrian-only areas, inscrutable road signs

facts.text: Salzburg's Old Town was named a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1997.
facts.excerpt: Salzburg’s Old Town, named a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1997
